english.meaning: all along; from the beginning until now
english.note: Usually appears as 不嬲都; with a negative it means never, as in 佢不嬲都唔係做文員.

exampleSentences.english: We always thought he said it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋，不嬲都以為佢講囖。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bat1 nau1 dou1 ji5 wai4 keoi5 gong2 lo1

exampleSentences.english: I’ve always supported Germany, but this time I really can’t see how they could win the title.
exampleSentences.traditional: 不嬲都捧德國，但係今屆我真係諗唔到佢有乜嘢原因可以攞到冠軍。
